expected_behavior: Resolves both targets and verifies whether one deployed head includes both changes; records the primary and related analyzed PR revisions
Uses read-only fetched Git objects if GitHub rejects a large diff; never substitutes the current checkout
Distinguishes published production snapshots from the latest production draft before asking for Bygger imports
Explains an import-source mismatch before overwriting shared preprod and agrees on a suitable reference or substitute

Preflights the pinned runtime and installed dependencies before selecting a generated-form validation approach; asks once about a blocker rather than repeatedly installing dependencies or requesting credentials
Preserves the approved behavior IDs and asks about material deferrals instead of silently dropping agreed checks
Reuses the form-flow JSON report for case labels, values and page order, and rejects nonexistent static option values
Runs committed-source citation validation and retains the distinction between source-mapped routes, local branch checks and preprod browser observations
On the non-developer path, ends with HTML and manual print/review instructions; never requires a PDF path or edits Trello
